name: Hardware Sensor CFA Suture Extractor (Demosaicing)
description: The ultimate physical optical DNA scanner. The Supreme Executioner of Computer Graphics (CG) and Generative Diffusion models. Fact: Every stunning digital camera exclusively captures monochrome (B&W) photons, forcing the chip to apply a Color Filter Array (Bayer masks of Red, Green, Blue) and mathematically guess (Demosaic) the missing colors for adjacent pixels. Synthesized AI imagery or digital art never physically pass through a hardware lens or Bayer sensor, entirely lacking this mandatory 'optical surgical suture' footprint.
algorithm: Interpolation Matrix Fracture Tracking (CFA Bayer Fingerprint)
mechanism: This armored tank crushes the visible RGB surface to violently reverse-engineer the image back to its 'primordial' Bayer matrix probability logic (RGGB/BGGR). It relentlessly sweeps the color grid, mathematically interrogating whether a pixel’s Blue channel was legitimately interpolated from its neighboring Green channels using hardware algorithms. If a deepfake face or Midjourney tree is spliced into the frame, the algorithm triggers a massive forensic meltdown upon detecting a complete absence—or violent collision—of CFA interpolation signatures, mathematically proving the imposter possesses no organic hardware origin.
parameters: Hardware Matrix: RGGB Bayer Array, Extrapolated Interpolation: Bilinear / AHD / VNG, Spatial Window Matrix: 5x5 Probe
accuracy: Supreme (83-93%) - A point-blank forensic shotgun blast to the temple of Deepfakes and pure Generative AI, decimating any excuse of organic authenticity.
source: Popescu & Farid (2005) - Optical CFA Interpolation & Digital Forgery Isolation
useCase: Aggressively cross-verifies the entire pixel mesh to definitively declare whether all interlocking parts of an image were gestated by the same metallic sensor mother, or barbarically spliced together from synthetic computational vats.

references.title: Popescu, A.C., & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing digital forgeries in color filter array interpolated images. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Anchors its attacks strictly to hardware physical inevitabilities. Micro-forging a synthetic Bayer interpolation fingerprint across a deepfake is a virtually insurmountable barrier for 99% of malicious actors.
• Immediately slaughters both Generative AI and cross-origin copy-pasted composites, as fusing elements from two different physical sensors inherently creates an irreconcilable mathematical war between their native Bayer traces.
limitations:
• The forensic blade is rendered utterly impotent if the photograph has suffered aggressive JPEG compression, heavy structural downscaling/resizing, or social media laundering (Facebook/WhatsApp); these processes permanently shred the fragile primordial Bayer pixel bonds.
• Completely neutralized when deployed against native monochrome (B&W) exports or images captured by the ultra-rare Foveon X3 sensors, which do not rely on Bayer demosaicing architecture.
